reviewed_invariants.name: Exact obligation coverage and case/version identity
reviewed_invariants.evidence: Manifest requires one string-ID item for every frozen stage, equal count and equal ID set; equality to frozen case/version is checked. Duplicate JSON keys are rejected during extraction.

reviewed_invariants.name: Original answer binding
reviewed_invariants.evidence: Execution checks frozen response/request hashes, retains byte-exact JSON body/span/hash; review re-extracts the one top-level named block from the original response and compares parsed content, span and body hash with the compilation receipt.

reviewed_invariants.name: Incomplete cannot receive a stage pass
reviewed_invariants.evidence: Any passing alignment-required stage triggers receipt validation and requires the candidate item status complete. Partial mathematical completion is distinct from successful compilation.

reviewed_invariants.name: Mapped declarations are in the actual audit inventory
reviewed_invariants.evidence: Both execution and review match (defining module, declaration name), and the source must be submitted or explicitly permitted frozen background. Review mapping must equal the candidate mapping for a passing obligation.

reviewed_invariants.name: Alternative proofs and valid background reuse
reviewed_invariants.evidence: No imposed candidate obligation order, reference dependency order or one-declaration-per-obligation constraint. Multiple declarations, shared declarations and explicitly permitted imported frozen definitions are accepted.

reviewed_invariants.name: Semantic versus syntactic/formal evidence
reviewed_invariants.evidence: Compiled inventory proves existence and axiom-audited Lean compilation, not proposition equivalence. Separate assumption/proof/scope review axes and per-stage notes remain mandatory.

closed_findings.original_issue: CH03-D07 background permission initially existed only in the evaluator contract while task wording referred to explicitly permitted obligations.
closed_findings.resolution: Root projected allow_background_declarations=true and an explanatory note into the CH03-D07 candidate obligation; reviewer checked equality with the frozen contract.

limitations: Read-only code and contract review; no repository changes.

Natural-language/Lean semantic alignment remains a substantive reviewer judgment; this gate does not infer it from compilation.
